epics.summary: UI test automation: Playwright suite for the sandbox web app
epics.description:
**Description:** Build and maintain the Playwright UI suite covering environment identity, auth, public blog, article lifecycle, categories, and account settings, against dev (full) and prod (read-only smoke). Locators must use data-testid; mutating specs gated to dev via runIfEnv/envGuard.
**Definition of done:** all P1/P2 UI cases automated, green on dev; prod smoke subset green; suites run headless in CI.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* Banner asserts DEVELOPMENT on dev and PRODUCTION on prod (TC-UI-001, 002)
* Anonymous nav shows login only; authed nav shows dashboard/categories/account/logout (TC-UI-003, 004)
* Runs green in both APP_ENV modes; no mutations.

epics.summary: API test automation: request-level suite from the OpenAPI spec
epics.description:
**Description:** Automate the REST API per /api/docs: meta, auth, articles, categories, comments, users. Assert status, shape, and meaning (authz matrix, validation, published-only rules). snake_case fields; wrapped create responses.
**Definition of done:** all P1/P2 API cases automated; prod smoke subset read-only; regression cases for the two fixed bugs permanently in suite.

tasks.summary: Automate auth API incl. serialization & cookie regressions
tasks.description:
**Acceptance criteria:**

* Login happy path returns token AND fully-populated user object — guards the empty-user serialization bug (TC-API-010)
* 401 paths for wrong password / unknown email / missing token on /me (TC-API-011, 012, 014)
* /me returns the token's user (TC-API-013)
* Set-Cookie flags: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure only under https — guards the Secure-on-http prod login bug (TC-API-015)
  **Covers:** TC-API-010..015

tasks.summary: Automate articles API: listing rules incl. draft-leak regression
tasks.description:
**Acceptance criteria:**

* Anonymous list is published-only; anonymous ?status=draft is force-overridden (TC-API-020, 021)
* Authenticated draft listing works for the owner (TC-API-022)
* Pagination bounds, search, category filters, 404 on missing id (TC-API-023..025)
* Delay param respected and capped (TC-API-033)
  **Covers:** TC-API-020..025, 033

subtasks.summary: TC-API-023 — Pagination bounds are rejected at the schema layer
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/blog/api/api-articles-edge.spec.ts. pageSize is maximum:50 and page is minimum:1 in the Fastify querystring schema, so out-of-range values return 400 (NOT a silent clamp — the service-level Math.min is defence-in-depth this surface never reaches). Also asserts the boundary pageSize=50 is valid. Read-only.

subtasks.summary: TC-API-024 — Search matches title OR body, case-insensitively
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/blog/api/api-articles-edge.spec.ts. Lower-cased term proves the ILIKE behaviour. Read-only.

subtasks.summary: TC-API-025 — The category filter takes a SLUG and narrows the list
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/blog/api/api-articles-edge.spec.ts. ?category= expects the category slug (not id or name); asserts every returned item carries that category. Read-only.

subtasks.summary: TC-API-070 — A draft article is readable by id without auth (list hides it, detail does not)
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/blog/api/api-articles-edge.spec.ts. PINS CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, which is arguably a defect: GET /api/articles force-overrides status to published for anonymous callers, but GET /api/articles/:id applies no status filter, so the seeded draft is fully readable by anyone who knows the id. See test-design/test-design-coverage-audit.md section 4, finding 1. If the app is hardened, this test must be updated deliberately. Read-only. Tag: @regression.

subtasks.summary: TC-API-071 — An authenticated author sees every author's drafts, not just their own
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/blog/api/api-articles-edge.spec.ts. PINS CURRENT BEHAVIOUR: ?status=draft applies no author_id scoping, so Robin can read Leo's draft. See test-design/test-design-coverage-audit.md section 2b. Read-only.

subtasks.summary: TC-API-043 — Comment validation: short name, short body, over-long body, malformed email

epics.summary: DB-layer verification and access-fence tests via Postgres MCP
epics.description:
**Description:** Direct database checks with per-student restricted credentials: golden-seed integrity, data-layer verification behind UI/API actions, and the permission fence itself (role grants + MCP restricted mode).
**Definition of done:** seed and fence suites automated; fence 12/12 after every reset; MCP-layer refusal demonstrated.

tasks.summary: Automate golden-seed integrity checks
tasks.description:
**Acceptance criteria:** table counts and fixed facts assert exactly after reset (TC-DB-001); referential integrity holds (TC-DB-002).
**Covers:** TC-DB-001, 002

subtasks.summary: TC-DB-001 — Blog golden-seed shape is exact after reset
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/db/db-integrity.spec.ts (NEW DB layer, via pg). Asserts users=4, categories=4, articles=7 (6 published + 1 draft), plus the fixed facts every other suite hard-codes: article 1 slug, article 7 draft owned by Leo. Dev-only; skips cleanly without STUDENT_DATABASE_URL. Tag: @regression.

subtasks.summary: TC-DB-002 — Blog seed referential integrity holds
subtasks.description: Automated: tests/db/db-integrity.spec.ts. Every articles.author_id resolves to a user, every non-null category_id resolves, every comment hangs off a real article. Dev-only.

tasks.summary: Automate data-layer verification behind app actions
tasks.description:
**Acceptance criteria:**

* API-created article row verified by SELECT (TC-DB-010); UI comment persisted (TC-DB-011)
* SQL draft-flip reflects in visibility, state restored (TC-DB-012)
* Validation-bypass teaching case: short body inserts at DB, rejected by API (TC-DB-013); raw user insert not loginable (TC-DB-014)
  **Covers:** TC-DB-010..014

tasks.summary: Automate the access fence incl. post-reset re-verification
tasks.description:
**Acceptance criteria:**

* verify-student-fence.sh 12/12 wired as an automated check (TC-DB-020..028)
* Reset + apply-student-role.sh → fence still 12/12 (TC-DB-029)
* MCP restricted mode refuses risky SQL before the DB layer (TC-DB-030); read queries match API ordering (TC-DB-031)
  **Covers:** TC-DB-020..031

subtasks.description: Automated: tests/store/api/store-edge.spec.ts. PINS CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, which is arguably a defect: POST /api/checkout/:orderId/pay registers no requireAuth and performs no owner comparison, so any caller who knows an order id can pay a stranger's pending order. See test-design/test-design-coverage-audit.md section 4, finding 2. If the app is hardened, this test must be updated deliberately. Dev-only.
